title: 1 HP Challenge
description: A simple mod that reduces HP to 1
body:
**Half Heart Challenge** is a lightweight, server-side friendly hardcore mod designed for custom challenges, multiplayer events, or extreme survival playthroughs. By default, the mod is completely disabled, allowing players to enjoy a standard Minecraft experience upon joining. 

However, server administrators can instantly trigger the hard mode for any player using a set of flexible commands and target selectors. When activated, the chosen player's maximum health drops to a single half-heart (1 HP). This state is saved directly into the player's data, meaning it will persist even after respawning or restarting the game.

**Available Commands (Requires OP/Cheats):**
* `/1hp @s on` — Enable 1 hp challenge for yourself.
* `/1hp @a off` — Disable the challenge and restore standard health for everyone.
* `/1hp <player_name> on` — Instantly set a specific player's health to half a heart.
* `/1hp @p off` — Restore normal health for the nearest player.

The mod fully supports standard Minecraft target selectors (`@a`, `@p`, `@s`, `@r`) and features handy Tab-completion for fast typing in the chat!
